title: Extend required farmer intake and API/error-state shell

acceptance.how: Use all 64 sourced districts with stable application IDs and searchable text selection; retain district-level provenance and distinguish intake selection from scientific coverage. INTAKE-UI is independent local preparation, not acceptance of this gate.
acceptance.verification: Selecting a national location does not imply validated advice there.

acceptance.text: Integrate the six required intake questions
acceptance.how: Keep all six visible in order: current crop, availability, dated previous history, usual upcoming baseline, water and priority. Require meaningful answers or explicit domain absence/fallow states; no demo prefill, soil/fertilizer form or general unknown bypass.
acceptance.verification: Invalid/dependent answers and contradictory dates fail with accessible errors; drafts remain separate from submitted answers.

acceptance.how: Require an explicit choice among the three priority presets, with no new-farmer default. Keep underlying evidence and hard constraints unchanged.
acceptance.verification: UI copy does not imply yield or calibrated success probabilities.

acceptance.text: Implement the agreed API adapter and states
acceptance.how: Create loading/error/unavailable/incomplete views against the accepted contract.
acceptance.verification: A failed/missing API never returns fictional chart/plan constants.

acceptance.text: Check bilingual and accessible input flows
acceptance.how: Review Bangla/English meaning, focus, keyboard, phone layout and reduced motion.
acceptance.verification: Record screenshots/manual checks and actual automated checks where implemented.

acceptance.text: Review and hand off the shell
acceptance.how: Fardin reviews transport assumptions; preserve illustrative labels until real G2 results arrive.
acceptance.verification: An independent reviewer can reproduce the bounded shell behavior.

history.note: Rebased planned work to the mandatory-now/future specifications. No product feature, review or delivery is marked complete.
Latest Fardin-authorized INTAKE-UI implements independent local form/validation preparation. G0 and all G1D acceptance remain pending; no scientific API adapter or integration is accepted.

next_action: Extend the current app against accepted G0 contracts; do not create a second frontend.
handoff: Prachurjo connects G3 only after G2 and this shell are accepted; Fardin reviews transport behavior.
purpose: Make field inputs and failure states usable before connecting scientific results.
